scope: Priority heroes and remaining catalogue HL2, episodes, Alyx and Portal characters; one normal request per target with exact version references.
reference_policy: Original Valve or Gearbox game models or official Valve promotional art hosted on Combine OverWiki. Source attribution was read and each input bitmap visually inspected before generation. No fan redesigns or mods.
review_method: Original PNG RGBA composited over white and neutral gray for internal QA only. Delivered PNGs unchanged. Candidate identity checks are not 1:1 certification, runtime integration or animation completion.
historical_refusals_policy: Earlier refusals preserved. Each target in this continuation receives one current normally worded request with its exact bitmap. A refusal is recorded without retry or rephrasing.

assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one single full-body high-resolution painted 2D fighting-game character sprite. Adapt the character to one clear ready stance in three-quarter SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT. Feet apart, whole body visible from top of head to soles, all hands and held equipment fully inside the canvas, generous transparent margins. One character, one pose, true transparent RGBA background including gaps between limbs. No environment, no floor, no separate shadow, no aura, no haze, no text, no labels, no border, no montage, no multiple views. The character is Gordon Freeman as depicted in the official Half-Life 2 promotional artwork Lonely Road, from Half-Life 2: Raising the Bar by Dhabih Eng. Preserve his short brown hair, black rectangular glasses, small brown goatee, gray neck collar, charcoal and orange HEV Mark V suit and orange chest panel with lambda emblem, orange thigh plates, black gloves and boots. Preserve the exact HEV Mark V panel divisions visible in the source. He holds the same simple red-shaft steel crowbar lowered in his right hand, other hand slightly forward in a calm ready stance. Remove all rubble, architecture, smoke and atmosphere from the reference. This is HL2 Gordon, not the HL1 Mark IV, not a different armor design.
assets.qa_notes: Lunettes, barbiche, pied-de-biche et découpe HEV Mark V repris de l’illustration officielle Lonely Road. Pose trois-quarts droite exploitable. La source est une illustration promotionnelle de Raising the Bar, pas une capture du modèle joueur retail; dimensions et faces non montrées ne sont pas certifiées.

source_attribution.Description: Gordon Freeman in the City 17 rubble. Artwork titled "Lonely Road".
source_attribution.Author: Dhabih Eng
